regions.summary: A selects a two-byte pointer at $8C00. Disable APU channels, copy eight stream-pointer bytes to $C2..C9, reset four note timers, then enable the four tonal/noise channels. Clear effect ownership and initialize cached pulse/noise volume.

units.name: SelectMusic
units.summary: A selects a two-byte pointer at $8C00. Disable APU channels, copy eight stream-pointer bytes to $C2..C9, reset four note timers, then enable the four tonal/noise channels. Clear effect ownership and initialize cached pulse/noise volume.

units.name: SelectSoundEffect
units.summary: Ignore a new effect while either effect channel owns hardware. Otherwise set ownership bits 7/6 and copy two stream pointers from the effect directory at $B840 into $E8..EB; clear their timers. A is the effect index, doubled for the directory.

regions.summary: Pulse 1 is a bytecode stream at ($C2), with a timer in $DA. A note packs pitch in the upper nibble and duration in the lower nibble. Duration is the shared base shifted by bits 0..2, plus half that value when bit 3 is set. Notes fetch a period pair through ($D2). Upper nibbles C..F dispatch controls: envelope/sweep, duration base, absolute stream jump, saved return, stream call, stop/rest, or period-table selection. Stream calls save one return pointer, not a nesting stack. Commit Y to the stream pointer only after processing the event. Envelope bit 4 selects direct volume; otherwise the envelope table supplies a held countdown and volume step.

regions.summary: Entry $F3BA reads an inline pointer from the caller; $F3BD accepts an existing pointer. Each record is PPU address high/low, count with vertical-increment flag in bit 7, then count tile bytes. A negative address-high byte terminates. Reset the PPU latch for each record and advance the CPU pointer by count plus three. Caller must have disabled rendering or provided a suitable PPU access window.

units.name: ReadInlinePointerAndSkip
units.summary: Use the stack return address to read two inline pointer bytes following the caller JSR and advance that return address by two. Stack offsets are relative to this nested helper call. Each supported call site has a separate two-byte inline pointer record. This stack contract does not imply a layout for arbitrary unrelated gaps.

units.name: InitializeTitleAudio
units.summary: Reset interrupt mode and sound requests, enable rendering and initialize the input signature before entering the title scene.

units.name: BuildTitleScene
units.summary: Select the title display resources, clear scene state and transfer the inline VRAM command record. Bank 13 supplies this scene code.

units.name: ActivateTitleScene
units.summary: Enable interrupt mode $0D and reset the title animation phase and scene counter.

units.name: ChooseAttractRoom
units.summary: Mask the country to eight choices; retry room selection until it is 1..6. Initialize the selected room and restart its scene counters.

units.name: JoinTitleSelection
units.summary: Join the common title selection continuation.

units.name: JoinTitleSelectionAgain
units.summary: Join the common title selection continuation.

units.name: BuildPasswordScene
units.summary: Select display resource 2 and transfer the inline password screen commands.

units.name: EditAndValidatePassword
units.summary: Edit ten letters A..Z with a wrapping cursor. Held combinations accelerate letter changes; Start validates two special passwords, then the two checksum letters. Decode the accepted payload into mode, completed-country mask, collection mask and progression. Invalid checksums return to the title failure path. Render a blinking cursor through the VRAM command buffer.

units.name: SelectPasswordModeMessage
units.summary: Mode 1 selects one inline screen message; other modes use the alternate record.

units.name: JoinPasswordModeMessage
units.summary: Join the selected message continuation, or transfer the alternate inline VRAM record.

units.name: WaitForPasswordStart
units.summary: Enable the display interrupt mode and wait for a newly pressed Start before continuing.

units.name: JoinCountrySelection
units.summary: Return to the shared country selection loop.

units.name: JoinCountrySelectionAgain
units.summary: Return to the shared country selection loop.

units.name: MoveTitleSpriteUp
units.summary: Move the scene sprite up one pixel before the shared title update.

units.name: ShowProgressionOverlay
units.summary: Upload the progression-selected display byte, temporarily hide the player and show an overlay. Wait for Select, then restore the player, display resources and scroll flags.

units.name: FinishRoomTransition
units.summary: After the secondary object finishes, run a 90-tick transition with player motion and collisions, hide both actors, restore CHR selection, increment the room and enter the next initialization. The local frame helper updates actors, projectiles and OAM before waiting.

units.name: JoinScoreUpdate
units.summary: Join the common score-display continuation.

units.name: JoinScoreUpdateAgain
units.summary: Join the common score-display continuation.

units.name: JoinScoreUpdateThird
units.summary: Join the common score-display continuation.

units.name: AwardDecimalScore
units.summary: Award fixed decimal amounts by selecting a digit and addend. Propagate carries left through the unpacked decimal score digits; each digit stays below ten.

units.name: FormatHighScore
units.summary: Replace leading zero digits with spaces, then write the remaining digits as character tiles. Queue the eight-character VRAM update.

units.name: JoinPlayerMotion
units.summary: Join the shared player motion continuation.

units.name: UpdateAlignedPlayerMotion
units.summary: Use the directional collision wrapper when the player Y position is not aligned to eight pixels, then join normal motion handling.

units.name: UpdatePlayerAttackAndPose
units.summary: Run attack and held-direction handling, or the alternate pose handler, then join the common player update.

units.name: JoinPlayerPose
units.summary: Join the common player pose continuation.

units.name: JoinPlayerUpdate
units.summary: Join the shared player update.

units.name: JoinPlayerUpdateAgain
units.summary: Join the shared player update.

units.name: JoinMotionState
units.summary: Join the common motion-state continuation.

units.name: StoreTileNibbleMotion
units.summary: Store the tile low nibble as the motion selection unless it is the reserved $0F value.

units.name: UpdateTileMotionAndHealth
units.summary: Store a non-$0F tile nibble. The following entry drains player health once per 32 phases when nonzero and gives one tick of immunity; it returns carry clear.

units.name: AdvancePlayerAnimationAge
units.summary: Increment the player animation age before joining the shared update.

units.name: StartPlayerFailureMusic
units.summary: Set the scene countdown to $F0 and request music 2.

units.name: ResolvePlayerRecoveryMotion
units.summary: Check the paired collision samples against $72 while moving upward; apply two horizontal steps in the selected direction. Select the next player pose/state from the recovery flags.

units.name: JoinPlayerRecovery
units.summary: Join the common recovery continuation.

units.name: BuildResultScene
units.summary: Select display resource 2, clear scene state and transfer inline result-screen commands.

units.name: UpdateHighScoreAndWait
units.summary: Compare eight unpacked score digits lexicographically and replace the high score when larger. Queue both score rows, animate the result display and wait for Start. The trailing entry begins direction-bit dispatch using the player state.

units.name: DispatchSecondDirection
units.summary: Shift to the next direction bit and tail-dispatch the player state when selected.

units.name: DispatchThirdDirection
units.summary: Shift to the next direction bit and tail-dispatch the player state when selected.

units.name: DispatchFourthDirection
units.summary: Shift to the final direction bit and tail-dispatch the player state when selected.

units.name: ReturnWithoutDirection
units.summary: Return when no tested directional action applies.

units.name: DispatchPlayerStateSecond
units.summary: Select a directional handler from the inline words using the player state.

units.name: DispatchPlayerStateThird
units.summary: Select a directional handler from the inline words using the player state.

units.name: DispatchPlayerStateFourth
units.summary: Select a directional handler from the inline words using the player state.

units.name: SetPlayerPoseFourteen
units.summary: Set player base and visible pose to $0E, then join the directional handler.

units.name: ResolvePlayerTileTransitions
units.summary: Inspect paired collision tiles. Tile pairs $68/$69 and $60/$61 select directional player states, while mismatched sides nudge horizontally. Set the intermediate pose and Y adjustment for the alternate state. The held-button entry restores standing pose when the button is released; another entry recognizes the special tile pairs and requests motion 8.

units.name: UpdatePlayerTraversalStates
units.summary: Finish tile-directed state selection. Age the traversal pose, alternate horizontal motion every other tick, and move vertically while checking paired tile samples. Return to standing state when the relevant collision condition ends.

units.name: MovePlayerRightAndFace
units.summary: Apply rightward motion, set facing bit $40 and join the position-change continuation.

units.name: MovePlayerLeftAndFace
units.summary: Clear facing after leftward helpers. Check the player world position and paired collision samples before subtracting one from the 16-bit X coordinate.

units.name: RunWeaponSelectionMenu
units.summary: Build a terminated list of available weapons and animate the inventory panel into view. Cycle the cursor forward or backward with wraparound, commit the selection, and animate the panel out. Build two-by-two tile commands for each weapon; blink the selected entry and skip unavailable mask bits.

units.name: StartWeaponProjectileMotion
units.summary: Return for the empty handler. Other entries reject offscreen projectiles, move horizontally or tail-dispatch projectile state. Slot $30 holds the active weapon projectile.

units.name: UpdateWeaponArcAndTimer
units.summary: Turn after the projectile fractional accumulator crosses its threshold, decode table-selected vertical/horizontal motion, animate, test collisions and hide on completion. A second entry decrements its lifetime every four phases and dispatches its state.

units.name: UpdateWeaponBounce
units.summary: Choose initial travel span from the held button, move using saved speed, and use the shared decaying vertical impulse. Preserve collision carry across the impulse accumulator update; hide on terminal collision. A separate projectile uses a terminated motion-byte stream and inline dispatch.

units.name: DispatchWeaponVerticalSteps
units.summary: Selected motion bytes either keep height, descend or ascend before the collision continuation. The next weapon clears motion flags, checks screen bounds and dispatches its state.

units.name: UpdateTimedWeaponBurst
units.summary: Choose travel span from held input, move with a decaying impulse, then enter a 120-tick animated burst. Toggle facing every fourth phase and hide when expired. The final entry is a fast horizontal projectile with screen-bound rejection.

units.name: CheckWeaponScreenBounds
units.summary: Subtract the 16-bit camera X from projectile X. Carry is clear only when the high difference is zero and low difference is in $08..$F0; other positions return carry set.

units.name: JoinCompanionUpdate
units.summary: Join the common companion rendering/collision continuation.

units.name: DispatchCompanionMotionStream
units.summary: Set companion pose and motion speeds, apply boundary-facing logic and dispatch the next byte of the looping stream; negative bytes reset its cursor.

units.name: UpdateCompanionMotionPhases
units.summary: Apply selected horizontal/vertical steps and animation, maintaining the companion phase flag. Another entry selects pose $26 and dispatches the next byte of its second motion stream.

units.name: AdvanceCompanionMotionStates
units.summary: Apply upward movement and optional pose change, or reset the state/cursor. Another entry selects the next motion byte with the standard speeds.

units.name: KeepCompanionFacingInBounds
units.summary: Apply the selected companion motion and animation. Shared facing helpers compare camera-relative X against $E0/$10 or $EC/$04 thresholds and toggle facing when the current direction would cross the limit.

units.name: TestCompanionObjectContact
units.summary: Test the companion slot against other objects. Use descriptor vulnerability flags to choose damage/contact handling, or defer while the companion immunity timer is nonzero.

units.name: TestWeaponObjectContact
units.summary: Test the weapon projectile against objects and filter target vulnerability by weapon mask. Select impact/damage parameters; hide nonpersistent projectiles and set the target auxiliary duration for the selected weapon.

units.name: ApplyPickupResourceChanges
units.summary: Hide the collected object and choose its effect from kind/flags. Add resource amounts with a cap, including half-value companion recovery where applicable. The final path grants the room-selected weapon by setting its ownership bit and selecting it if no projectile is active.

units.name: ApplySpecialPickupEffects
units.summary: Use the four-stage collection handshake before granting effects: extend resource capacity and UI bars, fill or half-fill resources, set temporary timers, or grant the country collection bit. The collection display streams paired tile bytes and waits between them; held A shortens the wait. Tail-dispatch collection state from its low two bits.

units.name: AnimatePickupCollection
units.summary: Advance collection through four states: stage an initial tile, wait 32 ticks, draw a two-by-two replacement, wait again, erase it, then hide the object and mark this room event consumed. Carry set reports completion; intermediate stages return clear.

units.name: DelayObjectBeforeDescriptorUpdate
units.summary: Set object immunity/countdown to 32 and join the descriptor update.

units.name: InitializePickupOrRoomObject
units.summary: Save the original object kind. For the reserved room slot, create an unowned room weapon using room metadata; otherwise derive pickup type/value from descriptor byte 15. Clear object state and auxiliary timers. Unsupported or exhausted objects are hidden, retaining their original Y in per-slot storage when required.

units.name: CycleRoomAnimationThreeFrames
units.summary: Advance the three-frame room animation only when its timing helper permits, then join the controller update.

units.name: DispatchRoomControllerPhase
units.summary: Tail-dispatch the controller phase using the supported inline word table.

units.name: UpdateRoomControllerMotionAndCycles
units.summary: Step controller timing through visible, hidden and randomized horizontal placement phases. A threshold accumulator advances the state; animation helpers wrap through independently bounded two- or three-frame lists before the shared controller update.

units.name: RunRoomCompletionAndEncodePassword
units.summary: Initialize spare object slots from the 16-byte template. Time the controller disappearance, special final-country resource refill, platform contact and input lock. The password entry marks the country complete, selects its progression, encodes eight A-based payload characters plus two checksum characters, and builds the next display.

units.name: JoinCompletionMessage
units.summary: Join the selected country completion message, or transfer the alternate inline record.

units.name: TransferCompletionMessage
units.summary: Transfer the selected inline completion message.

units.name: InitializeCompletionScene
units.summary: Upload display work and CHR selections, map PRG bank 12 at $8000, initialize camera/scroll and scene object templates, enable mode $0F and dispatch the player scene state.

units.name: RunCompletionSceneActors
units.summary: Walk the player into the scene, pause through timed pose phases, then walk out. Animate two other actors with randomized cycle starts until eight cycles finish. Start can advance to the terminal state; update scroll and progression display before each frame. The continuation advances the country modulo eight unless already at country seven.

units.name: CheckJewelCountComplete
units.summary: Continue the jewel-entry loop until all eight positions are filled.

units.name: RetryJewelOrder
units.summary: Return to the common jewel-order input path.

units.name: ContinueAcceptedJewelOrder
units.summary: Successful jewel validation enters the final scene. The following object helper finds an unused displayed jewel slot, copies position/kind/flags from the selected tables and remembers the chosen order byte.

units.name: JoinJewelCursorUpdate
units.summary: Join the shared jewel cursor update.

units.name: JoinJewelCursorUpdateAgain
units.summary: Join the shared jewel cursor update.

units.name: StartFinalSceneAudio
units.summary: Request music $18 and initialize the scene countdown to 180.

units.name: RunFinalSceneTransitions
units.summary: Change scroll flags and sound, wait 180 interrupt decrements, switch CHR, wait again, clear the scene and dispatch the ending variant from the mode low two bits. These are countdown waits, not a claim of natural ending reachability.

units.name: SelectEndingVariant
units.summary: Set ending variant zero and mode one, show its pages and final page nine, then wait for Start. Alternate entries select variants one/two with mode two and build an alternate inline scene.

units.name: PresentEndingPages
units.summary: Wait twice for 240 interrupt decrements before repeating the alternate scene. The page routine initializes display resources, maps text bank 11 at $8000, and uses the variant range to show each page for timed input-sensitive intervals. Finish with two scroll-flag flashes and return.

units.name: RenderEndingTextPage
units.summary: Read a little-endian page pointer from mapped bank 11 and render four rows of 25 characters. Convert spaces and five punctuation cases to tiles; letters subtract $40. Queue one row per interrupt wait and advance text by 25 and VRAM by $40. Following entries fade a selected palette byte in/out, preserving Y across 15 countdown waits.

units.name: CheckControllerDistance
units.summary: Return when the distance is outside the $18 threshold; otherwise continue the established controller test.

units.name: ReturnControllerTest
units.summary: Return from the controller test.

units.name: DispatchObjectMotionStream
units.summary: Advance the object motion cursor, wrap at $A8 and tail-dispatch the selected byte from the mapped stream.

units.name: HideObjectAtMotionEnd
units.summary: Mark object Y as $F1 and return.

units.name: HideObjectAtAlternateMotionEnd
units.summary: Mark object Y as $F1 and return.

units.name: RunObjectImpulseStates
units.summary: Initialize state one with speed $10 and impulse $20. Move until the shared horizontal test permits the decaying upward impulse, then test downward collision and advance to state three; the terminal handler only ages the animation.

units.name: RestoreObjectAfterDelay
units.summary: Wait for the auxiliary delay/lifetime, then restore a four-byte saved object record or descriptor-selected pose. A second path respawns on the opposite side of the player with a motion cursor chosen by player high X. Reset immunity, animation age and state; expired objects hide at $F8.

units.name: RunTimedObjectAnimation
units.summary: Wait for a timer, offset the base pose, then accumulate animation phase using speed plus game mode. Count completed phase-three cycles, select the recovery pose, wait its timer and return to state zero.

units.name: RunObjectEmissionCycle
units.summary: Build emission height and animation base from auxiliary fields, optionally adjust for player state five, and animate toward a bounded phase. Spawn a new object on the facing side using the descriptor-selected kind. Repeat after the emission delay/count, then enter recovery and reset state.

units.name: RunModeThreeMotionCycle
units.summary: Four states share the current slot: wait for the activation test, choose the next animation frame and delay; expire the delay, move horizontally and start the decaying impulse; continue motion until contact returns to state zero. State three is selected through the saved next-state byte $88. Current production of descriptor mode three remains unresolved.

units.name: RunFacingObjectImpulseCycle
units.summary: Preserve palette bits while applying facing; wait, move with an auxiliary speed and enter the shared impulse. On contact advance through activation/recovery delay and return to state zero.

units.name: RunObjectVerticalAttackCycle
units.summary: After activation, offset the base pose and move toward player height. Decelerate downward then upward motion in two-unit steps, wait for a vertical collision, recover and restore the base pose. The common descriptor update then loads contact parameters, checks collisions, refreshes facing periodically and applies horizontal/vertical motion.

units.name: AgeAndAnimateCurrentObject
units.summary: Age the current object and tail-call animation selection.

units.name: ContinueObjectCollisionMotion
units.summary: Continue only when the prior collision test permits. Reflect facing on paired horizontal flags or periodically refresh it, then load descriptor motion parameters, retain prior motion flags and animate the resulting movement.

units.name: DispatchMovingObjectStream
units.summary: Animate and move using descriptor speed; if movement permits, advance a wrapping $A8-byte motion stream and tail-dispatch its selected byte.

units.name: ReturnObjectStreamStep
units.summary: Return from the selected motion command.

units.name: ReadObjectMotionCursor
units.summary: Load the current stream cursor and join command decoding.

units.name: WrapReverseObjectMotionCursor
units.summary: Wrap a reverse cursor of $FF to $A7 before joining command decoding.

units.name: DispatchRandomMotionState
units.summary: Dispatch the current object state using the supported inline table.

units.name: RunRandomizedObjectMotion
units.summary: Read descriptor base speeds and random masks, store chosen horizontal speed and vertical impulse, then enter motion state one. Animate and move, apply a decaying upward impulse and hide/reset on completion. The shared impulse helper clamps each vertical step to $40, subtracts four from the remaining impulse and transitions through the caller-selected next state.

units.name: BeginObjectDownwardContactTest
units.summary: Return clear from the preceding test. The following entry clears the displacement result and uses the current object auxiliary contact cursor.

units.name: ReturnNoObjectContact
units.summary: Return carry clear when no matching contact applies.

units.name: FinishObjectContactTest
units.summary: On supported contact clear the auxiliary cursor and return set; otherwise preserve the negative result.

units.name: ClampObjectWorldXHigh
units.summary: Clamp world X high to one with fractional accumulator $1FF0 before joining the common motion result.

units.name: CommitObjectHorizontalAccumulator
units.summary: Commit the high/fractional X fields and check motion flag bit seven to select reflection versus hiding.

units.name: ResolveObjectHorizontalBoundary
units.summary: Commit the fractional high byte, inspect the prior motion nibble, reflect facing and return clear for a recoverable boundary; otherwise hide at Y=$F0 and return set.

units.name: SelectObjectVerticalDirection
units.summary: Return immediately for zero vertical speed. Select upward or downward helper from the vertical-direction selector.

units.name: CheckDownwardCollisionSamples
units.summary: Compare both sampled tiles with $68 before deciding whether to reject the vertical movement.

units.name: ClampObjectVerticalAccumulator
units.summary: Clamp the vertical accumulator to $0E00 and join the common result.

units.name: CheckUpwardCollisionSamples
units.summary: Compare both sampled tiles with $68 and preserve the carry contract for vertical movement.

units.name: ResolveObjectVerticalBoundary
units.summary: Commit the vertical accumulator. A retained boundary flag returns set; otherwise reconstruct its four-fractional-bit value from object Y. The final entry hides the object and returns set.

units.name: SpawnObjectInFreeSlot
units.summary: Scan slots $50..$F0 for hidden Y=$F8. Copy kind, flags, 16-bit X and Y from the prepared spawn fields, then initialize descriptor state. Return without spawning when all slots are occupied.

units.name: SampleAlignedObjectFootTiles
units.summary: Only sample when object Y plus frame offset ends in nibble $0F. Derive two foot positions from parallel frame-offset arrays, look up their tiles and return them in the shared sample pair; otherwise clear both samples.

units.name: DisableSceneForRoomSetup
units.summary: Request interrupt mode eight before continuing room setup.

units.name: JoinDescriptorInitialization
units.summary: Join shared descriptor initialization.

units.name: JoinDescriptorInitializationAgain
units.summary: Join shared descriptor initialization.

units.name: RecordObjectContactFlag
units.summary: Set the shared contact flag when the preceding carry test reports contact.

units.name: SelectTitleUploadPointers
units.summary: Select source pointers $8000, $8200 and $8400 for the shared display uploader.

units.name: SelectEndingUploadPointers
units.summary: Select source pointers $8D80, $8F80 and $9180 for the shared display uploader.

units.name: SaveInputSignatureAndControlNmi
units.summary: Save held input with a $55/$AA/$FF signature. Following helper entries clear/set PPUCTRL bit seven in both the shadow and hardware register.

units.name: SelectTitleChrBanks
units.summary: Select CHR registers 0,2,$70..$73 and tail-call the shared CHR writer.

units.name: SelectEndingChrBanks
units.summary: Select CHR registers 0,$32,$78..$7B and tail-call the shared CHR writer.

units.name: MergePaletteRecordBits
units.summary: Merge the low three saved bits with the mapped palette record and continue when nonzero.

units.name: RestoreCachedPrgBanks
units.summary: Select MMC3 PRG registers six and seven with values $86/$87, then write cached selections for CPU $8000/$A000. These cached mapper values alone do not establish arbitrary effective physical bank context.

units.name: InitializeResetStateAndEnterTitle
units.summary: Finish the initialization loop, disable display/audio and wait for two vblank observations. Clear RAM pages one through six; retain the top score area only when its four-byte warm-start signature matches. Initialize signatures, cached PRG banks 6/13 and CHR selections, camera/scroll, write mapper state and enter bank-13 title code at $B000. Reset establishes effective slots [6,13,14,15].

units.name: AudioPeriodEnvelopeData
units.summary: Audio period pointers, pitch values and envelope records read by the bank-8 channel interpreters. Individual directory and envelope extents are not all reconstructed.

units.name: AudioDirectoriesAndStreams
units.summary: Music and effect directories plus interpreted channel streams. The music directory is read at CPU $8C00 in bank 8; the effect directory at $B840 needs its matching data bank. Stream commands are data interpreted by the audio engine; individual song boundaries remain unresolved.

units.name: PreparedDisplayResources
units.summary: Prepared map, metatile and attribute arrays used by the title, altar and ending screen uploaders. Source pointers select separate arrays; the whole region is generic Data because not every original schema is reconstructed.

units.name: EndingTextDirectory
units.summary: Nineteen little-endian CPU pointers followed by nineteen 100-byte text pages. Each page is four rows of 25 ASCII characters; RenderEndingTextPage converts these to tiles. Variant start/end pairs and the final page select indices 0..18. Bank 11 must occupy CPU $8000.

units.summary: Bank-13 indexed room metadata, palettes, motion streams, object templates, jewel order/clues, country text and terminated VRAM records. Shared consumers establish non-code; complete table boundaries and original schemas are not all reconstructed. Executable scene code begins separately at CPU $B000.
